answer: At 21 units per epoch, sustaining 395 aliases for 51 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the copycat. The fee is charged through a wharf debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the dawn totals, and the falcon anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. A farm of 74 pays that 266 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
